who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), executor of plan 12 E2b, int-1112
what: The stability walk entered every body of the crate and asked hir::view::Semantics of each of its paths, method calls and fields, though almost every body names nothing deprecated or unstable and so can find nothing: a body edit re-ran the Semantics resolution of every body of the crate for no finding.
cost: a share of the `stability` crate pass on every body edit (plan 12 section 0: 5,672 analyze_impl spans of a six body edit across the names passes); not measured per pass
cause: the pass had no per-body fact saying a body cannot find anything, so the walk could not tell which subtrees to leave out without walking them
class: a crate-wide walk with no per-item verdict, redoing what an unchanged item would answer the same
prevention: every crate-wide names pass asks a per-body memo read from HIR (uses.rs) before walking a body's syntax
fix: written, uncompiled (2026-11-12): uses::named(db, owner) lists every def a body's HIR names (paths, their qualifiers and resolved prefixes, method calls, fields' variants) through BodyPaths::resolve; stability::body_quiet(db, owner, krate) is true when the body's own syntax has no macro call, attribute, item or constraint, its store no expansion, every name resolves and none is deprecated or another crate's unstable; the walk sweeps body_quiet on the workers (span `stability quiet bodies`) and steps over each quiet body's cut (Cx::pieces). Tests: stability::tests::the_walk_over_quiet_bodies_equals_the_whole_walk (control PrefixModulesIgnored) and a_quiet_body_is_not_walked (control NeverQuiet).
